d: About 5 months ago, fate brought us together to create something magical, and fate led us on this journey to explore our musicalities to come up with something we can be proud to present to the world. The song maintains its drive throughout and wraps around the folk-like composition making a beautiful blend of melodic magic. The addition of Khamaaj towards the end of the song adds a magical flair and provides a blissful conclusion to the song.
